node.seo_title: Acast Review | Pricing, Features & Podcast Benefits
node.meta_description: Read our Acast review covering pricing, features, pros & cons, monetization options and how it compares to other podcast hosting platforms.
node.overview_content:
Acast is a leading global podcast hosting, distribution, and monetization platform trusted by creators and publishers worldwide. In this Acast review by IdealOnlineBusiness.com, we explore its pricing, features, and ease of use based on multiple Acast reviews available online and real user experience. Whether you are launching your first podcast or scaling an established show, Acast offers tools that simplify hosting, distribution, and revenue generation from a single dashboard.
Our analysis of Acast reviews shows that the platform supports over 125,000 podcasts and delivers one billion listens per quarter. Acast pricing plans cater to hobbyists and professional creators alike, with options ranging from a free entry tier to feature-rich paid plans. Acast monetization reviews highlight its strength in connecting podcasters with thousands of global brands, making it a top choice for creators who want to turn their passion into income.
node.overview_listing_1_content: Acast automatically distributes your podcast to Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music, YouTube, Deezer, and more. You reach listeners on every major platform without managing individual submissions.
node.overview_listing_2_content: Acast connects eligible podcasters to over 3,300 advertisers through its marketplace. With just 1,000 monthly listeners, you can apply to start earning from dynamic ad insertion.
node.overview_listing_3_content: Acast uses AI-powered silence detection to place ads at natural pause points in your episodes. This keeps the listening experience smooth while maximising revenue for creators.
node.overview_listing_4_content: Track downloads, listener behaviour, and audience demographics through IAB-verified analytics. These insights help you grow your show and prove value to potential sponsors.
node.overview_listing_5_content: Acast provides a customisable podcast website with episode listings, social links, and an embedded audio player. It helps new listeners discover your content and follow your show.
node.overview_listing_6_content: Paid plans include automatic episode transcription powered by AI. Transcripts improve accessibility, boost SEO, and make repurposing content for blogs or social media easier.
node.overview_listing_7_content: Acast supports crowdfunding and listener subscription features, allowing fans to directly fund creators. This adds a recurring revenue stream alongside advertising income.
node.overview_listing_8_content: Acast pricing scales from a free starter option to professional paid tiers. Whether you are a solo creator or a media company, there is a plan designed to match your growth stage.
node.features_content:
Acast Features – What You Get?

Acast combines hosting, distribution, monetization, and analytics into one powerful platform. It is designed for podcasters who want to grow their audience and generate income without switching between multiple tools. Acast reviews consistently highlight its simplicity, global reach, and monetization capabilities as standout strengths for creators at every level.
node.features_listing:
• Unlimited podcast hosting and uploads
  • Distribution to all major podcast platforms
  • Dynamic ad insertion with AI placement
  • IAB-verified audience analytics
  • Access to 3,300+ brand advertisers
  • Built-in podcast website builder
  • Episode transcription on paid plans
  • Listener support and subscription tools
  • Free tier limited to 5 episodes
  • 50% commission on ad revenue
  • Basic website builder with limited design options
  • YouTube integration for video publishing
node.videos_content:
Video Guides and Tutorials

Acast provides a range of video tutorials and guides to help podcasters get started quickly. These resources cover setting up your show, connecting to distribution platforms, enabling monetization, and reading your analytics. Whether you are new to podcasting or switching from another host, these video guides reduce the learning curve and help you launch with confidence.
node.services_content: Acast offers a complete set of services that support every stage of the podcasting journey, from first episode to full-scale media production. Its services go beyond basic hosting by providing monetization infrastructure, audience analytics, and distribution management tailored for modern creators. Based on our Acast review research, many users appreciate the seamless combination of creation and commercial tools in one platform. Read more: Buzzsprout review | Podbean review | Riverside review
node.review_content:
Acast pricing is built around a tiered subscription model designed to support podcasters from their first episode to full professional production. Each plan unlocks additional features and monetization capabilities. Our review of Acast pricing shows that while the free tier has limitations, the paid plans offer strong value for creators serious about growing their audience and earning from their content.

Pros and Cons of Acast
node.reviewer_content: PodcastGrowth Agency Project Type: Podcast Hosting & Monetization Platform Evaluation "Acast stands out for its strong monetization infrastructure and global distribution reach. The dynamic ad insertion works well and the brand marketplace makes it easier to connect with advertisers than most competing platforms. The free tier is limited but the paid plans deliver real value for growing shows. The 50% ad revenue split is a trade-off worth considering, but for podcasters focused on building long-term income, Acast is a genuinely capable platform." EASE OF USE VALUE FOR MONEY CUSTOMER SUPPORT FUNCTIONALITY
node.alternatives_content: While Acast is a strong choice for podcast monetization and distribution, some creators may prefer platforms with different pricing models, better free tiers, or stronger analytics. These Acast alternatives are frequently compared by podcasters looking for the right hosting solution based on their audience size, budget, and revenue goals.
node.faqs_intro: We answer common queries about Acast review, Acast pricing, Acast features, and how Acast compares to other podcast hosting platforms. These answers help creators understand what Acast offers before making a commitment.
node.faq_1_content: Acast offers a limited free tier that supports up to 5 episodes. To access unlimited hosting, monetization, and advanced analytics, you will need one of the paid plans starting at around $14.99 per month.
node.faq_2_content: Acast connects eligible podcasters with its marketplace of over 3,300 brands. Once you reach 1,000 monthly listeners, you can apply to the ad network. Acast takes a 50% commission on ad revenue generated through the platform.
node.faq_3_title: What platforms does Acast distribute to?
node.faq_3_content: Acast automatically distributes your podcast to Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music, YouTube, Deezer, Podchaser, and Samsung. You can also manually submit to additional platforms like iHeartRadio.
node.faq_4_content: Yes. Acast provides IAB-verified analytics that track downloads, listener behaviour, geographic data, and platform breakdown. These insights help you understand your audience and attract sponsors.
node.faq_5_title: Can I switch to Acast from another host?
node.faq_5_content: Yes. Acast allows you to import an existing podcast by RSS feed. Your episode history, show notes, and metadata transfer over, making migration straightforward.
node.faq_6_content: Acast integrates with YouTube, allowing you to publish your podcast episodes as video content with just a few clicks. Video on Apple Podcasts is available through Acast in early access.
node.faq_7_title: What is the Acast Influencer plan?
node.faq_7_content: The Influencer plan is Acast's entry-level paid tier, priced around $25 per month. It includes unlimited hosting, full monetization access, transcription, and priority distribution to all platforms.
node.faq_8_title: Is Acast good for beginner podcasters?
node.faq_8_content: Acast is beginner-friendly with a clean interface and step-by-step setup. The free tier lets you test the platform before committing. However, beginners should be aware of the episode limit on the free plan.
node.faq_9_title: How does Acast compare to Buzzsprout?
node.faq_9_content: Buzzsprout offers simpler pricing and stronger beginner support, while Acast provides better monetization infrastructure and a larger advertiser network. The right choice depends on whether monetization or ease of use is your priority.
node.faq_10_title: Can I cancel my Acast subscription anytime?
node.faq_10_content: Yes. Acast subscriptions can be cancelled at any time. Your episodes and RSS feed remain accessible after cancellation, giving you time to migrate to another platform if needed.

node.seo_title: Adalo Review | Pricing, Features, No-Code App Builder
node.meta_description: Read our Adalo review covering pricing, features, pros & cons and how this no-code app builder helps you launch iOS and Android apps without coding.
node.overview_content:
Adalo is a powerful no-code app builder that enables entrepreneurs, startups, and businesses to create native iOS and Android apps without writing a single line of code. In this Adalo review by IdealOnlineBusiness.com, we explore its pricing, drag-and-drop builder, AI features, and publishing capabilities based on multiple Adalo reviews and real user experience. Whether you are validating an MVP or building a production-ready app, Adalo provides the tools to go from idea to app store in days.
Our analysis of Adalo reviews shows that the platform has over eight years of production app history and a growing AI toolkit. Adalo pricing is transparent and per-app based, starting from $36 per month for published apps. Following its 3.0 infrastructure overhaul in late 2025, Adalo delivers three to four times faster performance than earlier versions, making it a leading choice among no-code mobile app builders for non-technical founders and growing teams.
node.overview_listing_1_content: Adalo builds true native apps for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store from a single project. Unlike web wrappers, Adalo compiles to native code, ensuring better performance and app store compliance.
node.overview_listing_2_content: Adalo's canvas-based builder lets you design every screen visually without code. You can see your full app layout at once, drag components into place, and preview on any device in real time.
node.overview_listing_3_content: Adalo's AI Builder, Magic Start, generates complete app foundations from a text prompt. Magic Add lets you add features by describing what you want in natural language, accelerating development significantly.
node.overview_listing_4_content: Every Adalo plan includes a built-in visual database with no record limits on paid plans. You can also connect to external sources like Xano, Airtable, and Google Sheets for more advanced data management.
node.overview_listing_5_content: Adalo includes over 50 standard UI components including forms, lists, buttons, and navigation. The marketplace extends this with premium components, enabling complex app functionality without custom code.
node.overview_listing_6_content: Adalo integrates with Stripe for payments, Zapier for automation, Airtable for databases, and custom REST APIs. These connections let you build fully functional apps connected to your existing tools.
node.overview_listing_7_content: Unlike competitors that charge based on usage or capacity, Adalo uses flat-rate per-app pricing. This makes budget forecasting straightforward and eliminates surprise charges as your app scales.
node.overview_listing_8_content: Adalo's X-Ray feature identifies performance issues before they affect your users. It proactively highlights scalability concerns, helping you maintain a smooth experience as your user base grows.
node.features_content:
Adalo Features – What You Get?

Adalo combines a visual app builder, built-in database, AI tools, and native publishing into one platform. It is designed for founders and businesses who want to launch mobile apps quickly without hiring developers. Adalo reviews consistently highlight its ease of use, native app publishing, and predictable pricing as key advantages over competing no-code platforms.
node.features_listing:
• Native iOS and Android app publishing
  • Visual drag-and-drop canvas builder
  • AI-powered app generation with Magic Start
  • Built-in relational database included
  • 50+ standard UI components
  • Stripe, Zapier, and Airtable integrations
  • Flat-rate pricing with no usage caps
  • X-Ray performance monitoring
  • Per-app pricing can be expensive for multiple apps
  • Limited pixel-perfect design customisation
  • Learning curve for complex API integrations
  • Free tier available with 500 database records
node.videos_content:
Video Guides and Tutorials

Adalo offers a library of tutorials covering everything from building your first screen to publishing to the App Store and Google Play. These guides are suitable for complete beginners with no coding background and for experienced builders wanting to explore advanced features like custom actions and API integrations. Video resources help users get productive quickly and reduce the time from idea to live app.
node.services_content: Adalo provides a comprehensive set of services that cover the full app development lifecycle, from initial design to app store publishing and ongoing maintenance. These services are designed for non-technical users who want professional results without a development team. Based on our Adalo review research, many users value the combination of intuitive building tools and production-ready infrastructure. Read more: Webflow review | Builderall review | Leadpages review
node.services_list_1: No-code visual app design and building
node.services_list_2: Native iOS and Android app publishing
node.services_list_4: AI-assisted app generation and feature addition
node.services_list_6: App Store and Google Play submission assistance
node.services_list_8: Component marketplace and custom component support
node.review_content:
Adalo pricing follows a per-published-app model rather than feature-gating, which gives users access to the full builder on every paid plan. Our review of Adalo pricing shows that the platform offers strong value for single-app projects and startups validating one concept at a time. The free tier is genuinely useful for testing and prototyping before committing to a paid plan.

Pros and Cons of Adalo
node.reviewer_content: AppLaunch Solutions Project Type: No-Code Mobile App Builder Evaluation "Adalo is one of the strongest options for founders who need a native mobile app without hiring developers. The drag-and-drop builder is genuinely intuitive and the flat-rate pricing removes the unpredictability that plagues other platforms. The 3.0 infrastructure update has addressed most of the earlier performance concerns. For single-app projects or startups validating an MVP, Adalo delivers excellent value and real app store publishing capability." EASE OF USE VALUE FOR MONEY CUSTOMER SUPPORT FUNCTIONALITY
node.alternatives_content: While Adalo is a leading no-code app builder for native mobile apps, some users may prefer platforms with different database options, web-first capabilities, or lower entry costs. These Adalo alternatives are frequently compared by founders and developers exploring the best no-code tools for their specific app requirements.
node.faqs_intro: We answer common queries about Adalo review, Adalo pricing, Adalo features, and how Adalo compares to other no-code app builders. These answers help founders and businesses understand what Adalo offers before starting their first app.
node.faq_1_title: What is Adalo and how does it work?
node.faq_1_content: Adalo is a no-code app builder that lets you create native iOS and Android apps using a visual drag-and-drop interface. You design screens, connect a database, set up actions, and publish directly to the App Store and Google Play without writing code.
node.faq_2_content: Adalo offers a free plan with 500 database records for testing. Paid plans for publishing to app stores start at $36 per month. The Professional plan at $65 per month includes custom integrations and external database connections.
node.faq_3_title: Can Adalo build real native apps?
node.faq_3_content: Yes. Adalo builds true native iOS and Android apps, not web wrappers. Following the 3.0 infrastructure overhaul in late 2025, apps run three to four times faster and meet Apple and Google app store compliance standards.
node.faq_4_content: Yes. Every Adalo plan includes a built-in visual relational database with unlimited records on paid plans. You can also connect to external databases like Xano, Airtable, and Google Sheets on Professional plans.
node.faq_5_content: Adalo is designed for non-technical users and requires no coding knowledge. The visual builder is intuitive and the AI features, including Magic Start and Magic Add, help beginners generate app foundations from simple text prompts.
node.faq_6_content: Adalo integrates with Stripe for payments, Zapier for automation, Airtable for external databases, and custom REST APIs. The marketplace provides additional components and integrations to extend app functionality.
node.faq_7_title: How does Adalo compare to Bubble?
node.faq_7_content: Adalo is better suited for native mobile apps with predictable flat-rate pricing and faster time to launch. Bubble is stronger for complex web-only SaaS products that require advanced custom backend logic.
node.faq_8_title: Can I publish my Adalo app to the App Store?
node.faq_8_content: Yes. Adalo supports one-click publishing to both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store from all paid plans. The platform handles the technical requirements of app store submission for you.
node.faq_9_title: Does Adalo have a free plan?
node.faq_9_content: Yes. Adalo's free plan allows you to build and test your app with 500 database records. You can explore the full builder and AI tools before upgrading to a paid plan for app store publishing.
node.faq_10_content: Adalo released a major 3.0 infrastructure overhaul in late 2025, rewriting 176 backend services. This resulted in three to four times faster app performance, improved scalability, and a more stable foundation for production apps.
